title: From Theory to Decision Rule: Calibrating the Noisy-Label Crossover for Vision-Language Model Weak Supervision Across Three Medical-Imaging Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2605.24771v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In medical imaging, small sets of expert labels are often combined with zero-shot pseudo-labels from a vision-language model (VLM). When the expert-labeled set is very small, the extra pseudo-labels reduce variance and improve accuracy. Once a classifier trained on expert labels alone reaches the accuracy of the weak labeler, however, adding pseudo-labels lowers test performance. We measure where this crossover occurs on PatchCamelyon histopathology, ISIC 2019 dermoscopy, and NIH ChestX-ray14 radiography using pseudo-labels from BiomedCLIP and PubMedCLIP across six student architectures ($8\mathrm{M}$ to $89\mathrm{M}$ parameters). Weak labels stop helping after $20$--$50$ expert labels on ISIC 2019, about $100$ on PatchCamelyon, and $250$--$500$ on NIH ChestX-ray14. translated_title: 从理论到决策规则：在三个医学影像基准上校准视觉-语言模型弱监督的噪声标签交叉点
translated_abstract: 在医学影像领域，少量专家标注通常与来自视觉-语言模型（VLM）的零样本伪标签相结合。当专家标注集非常小时，额外的伪标签能够降低方差并提升准确率；然而，一旦仅用专家标注训练的分类器达到弱标注器的准确率水平，加入伪标签反而会降低测试性能。我们在PatchCamelyon组织病理学、ISIC 2019皮肤镜和NIH ChestX-ray14放射影像三个数据集上，使用BiomedCLIP和PubMedCLIP生成的伪标签，并在六种学生架构（800万至8900万参数）上测量了该交叉点出现的位置。结果显示：在ISIC 2019上，弱标签在专家标注达到20–50个后不再有帮助；在PatchCamelyon上约为100个；在NIH ChestX-ray14上为250–500个。超过这些标注预算后，加入10000个伪标签会使测试宏平均AUC最多下降0.14个百分点（ISIC 2019上BiomedCLIP，PubMedCLIP为0.23），（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文在三个医学影像基准上实证测定了视觉-语言模型伪标签从有益转为有害的交叉点，并将其转化为可操作的专家标注数量预算决策规则。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically calibrates the crossover point at which VLM-generated pseudo-labels stop helping and start hurting test performance across three medical-imaging benchmarks, providing practical decision rules for expert-label budgets.
